instruction: Increase GIMP's maximum undo levels to 10 steps.

metadata.explanation: Task requires setting undo levels to 10 via Edit > Preferences > Environment > Undo. The evaluator checks gimprc config file for '(undo-levels 10)' entry. Similar configuration task to the original.
